title: Mortgage Statement
description: Fields extracted from a monthly mortgage statement.  EXTRACTION ONLY — this is not an underwriting decision.

amount_due.description: Total amount due (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

principal_balance.description: Outstanding principal balance (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

escrow_balance.description: Escrow balance (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

principal_portion.description: Principal portion of payment (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

interest_portion.description: Interest portion of payment (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

escrow_portion.description: Escrow portion of payment (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

past_due_amount.description: Past due amount if any (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

late_fees.description: Late fees if any (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

potential_inconsistencies.description: Observations that look inconsistent. NOT conclusions.

missing_information.description: Fields the document should contain but does not.

human_verification_items.description: Things a human must confirm against the source before relying on them.

snippet.description: Verbatim text the value came from

source_references.description: Where each important value was found.
